decision.summary: A multi-sample abrupt shift in N and E occurs at indices 490–494: N jumps upward (~0.2→~1.7), E drops sharply (~-2.6→~-4.2), and U rises. The offset persists through the remainder of the allowed context (to index 579) with no observed return to pre-shift levels; thus the interval is classified as uncertain due to ambiguous reversal.

intervals.observation: N rises sharply from ~0.2 to ~1.7 and E drops from ~-2.6 to ~-4.2 over indices 490–494; U also increases. No clear opposing return observed within allowed context (up to 579); post-494 values remain offset (e.g., N ~1.0–2.5, E ~-3.5 to -5.8), suggesting incomplete reversal.
